text:
liam: Pager alert - eu-west-2 capacity degrade, GPU pool gpux-3 reported 30% pod evictions and repeated OOMs. Paging oncall.

pagerbot: [ALERT] Severity: P2 - eu-west-2 infer-cluster degraded. Affected services: hosted-api, dedicated. Trigger: node-oom-rate > 0.2 over 5m. Incident ID: INC-20260318-1

sophia: I'm oncall, looking. Anyone already shifted traffic?

ana: Not yet. We should move non-critical inference to eu-west-1 and reduce batch sizes. I'll prepare the traffic-shift command.

devon: Can we do a canary shift first? 10% -> 50% over 10m.

liam: Agreed. Also seeing network egress spikes on two racks in the metrics panel. Could be host NIC flaps.

ana: Running routing playbook now. Command I'm using:
```
redwood-cli traffic shift --from eu-west-2 --to eu-west-1 --service hosted-api --percent 10 --duration 10m --strategy canary
```

infra-bot: Action queued: traffic shift 10% initiated by ana. JobID: TS-23345

sophia: Monitoring. If errors > 2% we rollback immediately.

liam: Paging policy note: current node-oom alert is noisy for transient preemption. I propose we tweak the rule to fire pager only for sustained >3m combined with pod eviction rate >0.15. Can someone open a PR?

ana: I'll open a PR with the updated rule and add a short rationale. Keep paging at P1 only for sustained cases.

devon: Also recommend updating the runbook to include `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets` for affected nodes and a manual annotation step marking capacity as degraded in the console.

sophia: Handoff: I'll be handing off at 04:00 UTC to devon. Leaving the dashboards pinned and the eviction panel on top.

devon: Taking over at 04:00 UTC. Please post the exact steps you ran here for the handoff.

liam: Steps I ran: reduced default batch_size from 16->8 for hosted-api, enabled kv-cache warmup offload, and temporarily disabled auto-burst for dedicated pools. Latency stable so far.

ana: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/infra-alerts/pull/742 — updates alert thresholds + doc. :eyes:

infra-bot: Traffic shift TS-23345 at 10% complete. Observed error rate 0.7% (baseline 0.5%) — within current threshold.

pagerbot: [INC-20260318-1] Severity downgraded to P3 after mitigation. Auto-close scheduled in 2h if stable.

sophia: Follow-ups I'll create tickets for: 1) Formal paging-rule change (link PR), 2) Post-mortem doc + owners, 3) Capacity request for +8 GPUs in eu-west-2 (to cover preemptions).

devon: Acknowledged. I'll run a 2h soak with increased logging on affected racks. :thumbsup:

liam: Quick ops note for future on-call handoffs: include whether traffic shift was canary or immediate and JobID (e.g., TS-23345) in the header of the handoff message.

ana: Added a short comment to the runbook under "traffic shifts" to require JobID and percent.

devon: Closing note — system stable, no further evictions in last 20m. Leaving monitor pinned. Will close thread if no regressions in 2h. :wave:
